[h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

It seems like a lie that it's been almost a year and a half since my supermarket was released in early access, but it really has.
During this time different features have been added, new items, new products, new ways of customizing the supermarket and even the possibility of opening a café inside the supermarket.

Thanks to everyone who took part in this adventure and gave feedback, especially on discord!

Does this mean that the game will no longer be updated? Not a chance!
I still have a few more things I'd love to add, including new achievements and modding to allow any product to be added to the game. In addition, optimizations will still be made and bugs fixed!

Sometimes it took longer than usual to release what I wanted, but overall, I'm quite happy with the result considering that I didn't have any outside help in the development apart from the support of the wonderful community in fixing bugs, translations and coming up with great ideas. [h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

notes.title: Staff Tasks Revamp | New Coffee Tasks | 07/05
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

Today I bring you a revamped task system for the staff, as well as new tasks for the coffee area!
Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Discord Server[/url] and help with bug reports, ideas or even just to chat!


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ad439a62cee40d11e9e0f525282664390c901346.png[/img] Game Changes[/h1]

[h2]Staff[/h2]
Previously, each employee had a single, player-defined task. There is now a priority system within each area of the supermarket.
[list]
[*] Employees can now be assigned to a specific area. For now, Supermarket or Coffee.
[*] Employees can now have different priorities for each task inside their area:
[list]
[*] High
[*] Standard
[*] Low
[*] Disabled

[b]Quick explanation:[/b] The employee will check which of the high priority tasks needs to be done and is more urgent. If there is nothing to do, he will check the default priority and repeat the process until he reaches the low priority.
It is worth mention that employees can still be assigned to a single task. For example, assigning an employee to the cash register while blocking all other tasks will make the employee stay in the cash register until his priorities change or he gets tired.
[/list]

[*] Two new tasks have been added to the coffee area:
[list]
[*][b]Serving[/b] - Includes handing out menus, taking orders and fetching/delivering food to customers.
[*][b]Cooking[/b] - Includes making food or drinks, cutting and sorting in food displays where possible.
If you find some wrong behavior in this new tasks or want to provide feedback on how to improve them, feel free to send me a message! 😁
[/list]

[*] A new tab has been added to the employee application, where it is possible to check all priorities of all employees at the same time and define their priorities for each task.
[*] Employees will no longer take into account other objects that are being interacted by other employees. This means, no more 5 employees trying to restock the same shelf. 🥳
[*] Employees will now prioritize litter, paper, and dropped bags that are closer to them. 
[*] Employees will now prioritize trash bins that are more full.
[*] Employees will now prioritize chairs that are more comfortable and closer to them to take a break.
[*] Employees will now properly handle products left on the street. They will move the products to desired racks and eventually to racks with empty spaces.
[/list]

[h2]Customers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Customers will now start to leave if the store is about to close. Be careful, because closing the store abruptly can cause all the customers to rush to the cash registers to pay and leave.
[*] The customer's coffee product interface will only appear when the player is close enough to the customer. This avoids the crazy icon madness when you have multiple customers in the coffee area.
[*] The coffee products delivered to the customer will disappear from your head instead of having the product there with a check mark. This should further help with the mess of product icons that appear when customers are too close to each other.
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated engine version. Should fix some crashes and issues.
[*] Moved Apple Juice category to Drinks and Bottles.
[*] Temporarily removed the delivery kiosk from the store. It will come back in the next update fully implemented with the delivery services.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]🪲 Bugs Smashed[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the employees were not going to the cash register with more customers at the checkout waiting.
[*] Fixed an issue where employees would start restocking the same shelf all together after some minutes in-game.
[*] Fixed some weird pathing of customers and employees when moving around coffee tables and chairs.
[*] Fixed an issue where products in delivery guys hands were counting as available products for recipes in coffee area.
[*] Fixed some wrong scaling text in some languages.
[*] Fixed some wrong/missing translations.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

For the next patch, I'll be focusing on adding new items and products, as well as the long-awaited delivery services! Also will be taking a look at performance issues reported!

Stay tuned and hope you enjoy the update!
🔥 Nero Games

notes.title: Coffee Expansion | 03/08 | Real Supermarket comes to life!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙[/h1]

Sorry for the long time without new updates but the time has come!
This is the biggest update coming to the supermarket and brings the game one step close to the final vision.
Hope you join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Official Discord Server[/url] and help develop the game with your amazing ideas!

Something I will be reworking in the next weeks is the reputation system.
As more and more items are added in, the unlock time between products is too small for the player to handle the new product without having unhappy customers in the store.
For this, the player will now win reputation stars that will be added infinitely and those will allow the player to unlock any product he wants.

Also, here is the roadmap of features coming next:
- Rework on the current reputation system in order to accommodate new product
- Build own supermarket and customize walls, floors and more
- Delivery Services
- Achievements

[hr][/hr]

 [h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ad439a62cee40d11e9e0f525282664390c901346.png[/img] Game Changes[/h1]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/6f63ba1847f8e65114247408efd2593b0532cccd.png[/img] Coffee Expansion[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/f4d266d7658b9c17eaafd41306b13d63bb403386.png[/img]

[list]
Now there is the possibility to run a coffee shop inside your supermarket. This means you need to attend customers, take their orders and serve them the products they desire. The products available are yours to decide.
Also, if you decide to run only the coffee and no grocery store, that's also possible!
At the moment employees cannot be assign to any coffee shop task but that's something changing in the near future!

[*] Player can enable coffee area after the first day in the administration app.
[*] Grocery store can now be disabled also in the administration app.
[/list]


[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/1556fa9bdb3524e4126613e9f35540e054395365.png[/img] Crafting Products[/h3]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ab0f84f483d6bdc45dfa05b113c994b7a3212d6a.png[/img]

[*] In this expansion, some products (presented below) will require to be crafted/baked.
[*] Each product have now some recipe that requires some products in order to craft. This products can be in the storage racks and don't require the player to being holding them in their hands.
[*] Some products will required to be cut in a cutting board, before served or even stored in the display shelf.

Quick note: Like I mention above, the reputation system will be reworked and you will be able to choose what products you want to unlock at any point in the game. This will improve the recipes since you will also be able to pick what products you must unlock to craft some recipe you want.
[/list]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/42d596fd86b4f45907e72db368eb395ef96be1dd.png[/img] Coffee Menu Application[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added to the tablet a new application called "Coffee Menu". This App is unlocked when you enable the coffee area inside your administration application.
[*] Inside the application you will be able to:
[list]
[*] Add/remove products to/from your coffee menu
[*] Change the product price.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/16d6f0b52f278552870ccca17731c93ea00ab041.png[/img] Products Price Customization[/h2]
[list]
Alongside with the possibility to change every product price, customers will also take into consideration for how much you are selling the product and how much it costs daily.

[*] Products prices are now applied daily instead of hourly.
[*] Players can change all products selling price.
[*] While changing the price there is a face reflecting the current selling price compared to the buy price. This will help identifying when you are pushing too much on the price or making a good discount price! 
[*] Customers will take into consideration the current selling price and how different it is from the current daily price of that product (buy price). This will force the player to run low prices to avoid unhappy customers or keep updating daily the prices to reflect the current market situation.
[*] Customers now have a tolerance to high prices. Abusing it may end up with the customer being unhappy and take no product at all.
[*] Customers now can take more products than they initially intended. This mean the player can run some discount promotions on some products to quickly empty the stock of some product.
[*] Any product price change will show a notification to other players telling who changed the price of what product.

When players are grabbing some product from the shelf, they will check the price of that product. New emotes were added to reflect what the customer thinks of the price:
[/list]

[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/f30bec0f9526972ae5a0ba5acb91c18be3a5e759.png[/img] Green Sign - Customer thinks the product cheap and decided to grab more than they initially wanted.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/91b14065f14bcdba7aa2f5df4ed79826521ffc7a.png[/img] Yellow Sign - Customer thinks the product expensive and they are taking less than they initially wanted.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/410b94dbe3f64b21d2244659616a3e0e1141c7e2.png[/img] Red Sign - Customer thinks the product is abusive and is not taking any product at that selling price.

If no sign shows up, means the customer is accepting that product price and is taking the full amount intended of that product.
Also, this will affect the happiness of the customer and eventually the reputation gain. If the customer finds expensive, he will be unhappy while in the other hand, cheaper promotions will keep customers happier and increase the reputation gain.
[/list]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/e1759dbcd2e4b52bf059cf83fb84a7e1e8525d18.png[/img] Warehouse Stock Manager[/h2]
[list]
[*] New service Stock Manager added to Services Application. Activating this service will enable the Warehouse Stock Application.
[*] This stock manager will automatically buy the products you want when some criteria is met.
[*] The stock manager will check if he needs to buy new products every hour.
[*] If there is not enough money, the stock manager will send a message to warn the players.
[*] In this new application you will be able to:
[list]
[*] Check ALL the stock you have of ANY product.
[*] Turn On/Off the auto-buy of any product.
[*] Set the minimum stock level to order that product.
[*] Set the maximum price to order that product.
[*] Set the quantity to order.
[/list]
Both the minimum stock level and the maximum price must be met for the stock manager to buy the product.
[/list]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/5621579e91c58101437a35e053d73c304312622e.png[/img] New Game Customization[/h2]

This will allow the players to customize uniquely their game experience while providing also some predefined game modes like easy, normal and hard.

[*] When starting a new game, options menu is now available under the store name.
[*] Different presets can now be picked (Easy, Normal and Hard).
[*] Game mode called Sandbox is available where the player have unlimited money, reputation and everything will be unlocked since the beginning. Some other parameters can still be changed with sandbox selected like reputation multiplier, customers frequency or happiness modifier.

With this settings, you can customize uniquely the experience of a new game.
Imagine you want to start with employees right from the beginning? Just unlock all tablet applications and hire employees right away!
Want to switch to coffee shop since the beginning and ignore grocery? Unlock all tablet applications, go to administration app and switch them!

notes.title: 11/24 - Gamepad support, bug fixes and beta branch!
notes.content:
Greetings, cash register wizards! 🛒🧙‍♀️🧙

Today I'm bringing you a rework of the inputs and also support for gamepads!
This took more time than I expected, but I think it's in good shape to officially support gamepads.

I would also like to introduce a new beta branch. As some of you may know, I'm currently developing this game all by myself, and sometimes I rush some updates that haven't had enough testing. Some of you have been kind enough to ask how you can help. So I'm going to create this branch on steam that will give you access to the latest builds for testing!
If you are interested, feel free to read more at the end!

I'm also still working on the following:

[*] Character customization
[*] Product price customization
[*] Delivery and Warehouse services
[/list]
This should be in the game during the next big patch in December!

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Features/Improvements[/h2]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] General Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Halloween theme has been removed from the game. The items and furniture are still in the game!
[*] Updated game engine. Should fix some crashes.
[*] The input system has been reworked. Now you can remap things like the character's WASD movement.
[*] Updated the controllers section in the settings menu.
[*] Gamepad is now supported. 🎮🥳
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/1f13a01e70d17786b25077e19b126f2ebe69e69e.png[/img] Issues Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some translations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the delivery guy put the products on the wrong shelf..
[*] Fixed an issue issue where the large storage rack was not working properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could jump or punch while interacting with the cash register.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Gamepad 🎮[/h2]

From now on I'm officially supporting gamepads. No matter if it is xbox, playstation or even nintendo switch gamepad.
Everything should work properly for you to just connect your gamepad to the computer and just play.

There is a virtual cursor to interact with the tablet components, while also some buttons to speed up the process, like ordering x100 of some product at once, just like it was with the keyboard/mouse using CTRL and SHIFT while clicking on some product.

In the game there are also changes where you can just switch between keyboard and gamepad, the game will automatically detect the new inputs and adapt the game and interface for that gamepad.

Something that's missing that I'll be adding in the future is the icons for each gamepad. For example, the default interaction button in the gamepads is the south button, which is [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/998254fae8d6ebef59e084d51d08506ca925b7e0.png[/img] for Xbox or [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/7e8888c8b1a2914b05ed96fd853b1b90cbb2e9ba.png[/img] for Playstation.


Also remember that you can reassign any button you want in the settings menu!
I hope to get some feedback from players who decide to give the gamepad a try. ❤️

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Beta Branch[/h2]

So you are interested in helping test new builds before they are released to the general public? That's great, thank you very much for your help!

You can access the beta branch in Steam.
Go to your library, right click on My SuperMarket and then Properties...
After that you should see a tab called "Betas".
All you have to do is type in "mysmbetatester" and click "Check Code".
This will unlock the beta branch, where you just need to press the new button and it will start installing the beta branch. In your library you should see the name of the game like "My SuperMarket [beta]".

[h3]How do I leave the beta branch?[/h3]
Go back to the same tab and in the first field that shows beta participation just select "None". The game will revert back to the normal branch.
In the future, if you want, you can simply select the beta branch again to test some new features!

[h3]Reporting bugs in the beta branch[/h3]
In order to keep this under control, I ask that you use the "beta-branch" discord channel to discuss or report games found in this particular release.

notes.title: 09/15 - Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
Greetings, Shelf Stockers! 🛒🍎

Today I'm bringing more bug fixes and two small additions to the game that will be expanded in the future.

Before the notes, there is currently a bug when loading your saved game that does not load everything properly and your store will be empty. No furniture, no products, not even lights.

I'm already trying to find the source of the problem and hopefully this will be fixed in this latest version (0.4.33).
If this happens to you, please don't exit to the menu, save the game, or even submit a bug report in-game. Close the game with ALT+F4 and send the save file directly to me via [url=https://discord.com/invite/JZsQrn9HJK]Discord[/url] or email to support@nerogames.pt.

I'm currently releasing new versions every few hours to get to the bottom of this.
Sorry for this problem! 😞

[hr][/hr]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] The engine version has been updated to the latest version. This should help with some random crashes that some players were experiencing.
[*] Some optimizations have been made to improve performance. This should be especially noticeable as your store grows.
[*] The navigation system is now loaded from a pre-generated file instead of being calculated at runtime. This will improve performance and also the frame drops when loading the game or even expanding the store.
[*] Added missing translations for the banking application.
[*]Reputation drop is now halved. This doesn't mean it's easier to progress, but it's easier to keep your current reputation without dropping too much if things get out of hand.
[*] Now there is a real bus stop in front of the shop! 🚏
[*] Thieves now move much slower and have a different animation than other customers. 
[/list]

[h2]New Services[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a new application in the tablet called 'Services'. This will provide some services that you can hire to improve your store.
[*] The first service is 'Security'. With this service you will have 24/7 protection against thieves. Don't hit the cop outside... 👌
[/list]

Currently, I've planned two more services. One is a delivery service, where you will have to handle some delivery packages to be handed to the deliveryman.
Another is a stock management tool, where you will be able to define a minimum stock for each product and they will be bought when the stock gets below the threshold.


[h2]Staff Training[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now you can train your employees.
[*] You can choose which trait you want to train and the amount of time/money you want to spend. While the employee is training, he will be out of town 🏃‍♂️
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rain in the store? I called the plumber and he fixed it. 😎
[*] Fixed an issue where employees would get stuck against each other in the middle of the store.
[*] Money changes are now displayed in the bottom left corner in order instead of all at once.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could interact with the open/close button from outside the store.
[*] Fixed an issue with the store sound announcer after expanding the store.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was disconnected when unlocking a store expansion.
[/list]

As for the second floor store expansion, I'm still working on it! I just need more time to finish it!
Thanks to all of you who continue to help improve the game! ❤️❤️❤️

[/list]

[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/83746fa6eb6cd2a4c16849f5b114d775bf88471a.png[/img] Bankruptcy[/h3]
Before, you couldn't really lose the game in any way. Even if your balance went negative, it would be okay because you would probably be able to make it back in the next few minutes.
This is something I want to keep in the game since the main goal here is for you to have fun and not to get into a fully complex management game.

Now, you will go bankrupt if your balance stays below zero for seven days in a row. If that happens, it's game over.
There will be new warnings when this happens and also when there are 3 and 1 days left for bankruptcy.

One way to combat immediate bankruptcy would be to take out a loan in the new banking app, but remember that this is only a temporary solution.

[list]
[*] New bankruptcy scenario that happens when your bank balance is below zero for 7 consecutive days.
[*] New bankruptcy warning notifications.

[h2]What's coming next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Store Expansion[/b] - It's time to expand the store. This gonna be released in two separated parts, one where it will be possible to expand the store in the ground floor and next, different floors!

[*] [b]More Furniture[/b] - Expect a bunch of new furniture in the next big patch. In all categories!
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[h3]Staff Application (Tablet)[/h3]

New Staff application will be unlocked when achieving half your first reputation star.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/045af4206f35cf5b3fdc455a0cc0ee73e168e50b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/0a8756a59d10380104d519a16955e6b2bfdd95ac.png[/img]

In this app you will find two tabs:
[list]
[*] [b]Recruitment[/b] - Where you can post job ads, spend money, and search for candidates. The number of candidates that apply is influenced by two factors: the amount of time or money spent advertising and the reputation of the store. Stores with a higher reputation will attract job candidates with better qualifications.
[*] [b]Employees[/b] - This is where you can find a list of all the currently employed workers. You can review task assignments, current progress, and schedules. You can assign a work schedule for each employee and task. In addition, you have the option to terminate an employee's services if you no longer require them.
[/list]

The current employee tasks are:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/64aeeb57916c051b96ce5998e67ae7dcdf289748.png[/img] Restocking[/b] - Check the empty shelves and get the products restock. In first place, if some product is available in a storage rack and not placed in a shelf, the employee will try to get those first. If there aren't new products, they will try to restock the shelf with lowest product quantity.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/01201198ea28b75fb3903c4f1b91431151d305f2.png[/img] Cleaning[/b] - While cleaning, employees will complete four tasks to keep the store clean: cleaning dirt from the floor, picking up papers, retrieving any bags dropped by customers, and emptying the trash bins.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/76953968639ba1fa491ddf3b755d75e40dea0b96.png[/img] Cashier[/b] - The employee will go to one of the available cash registers and scan all the products.
[/list]


[h3]Employees[/h3]
Each employee will have three main stats:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/1f13a01e70d17786b25077e19b126f2ebe69e69e.png[/img] Speed[/b] - Affects the speed of tasks like scanning products at the cash register or cleaning the store.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/c4e56dc18493f5592e28814d050ef1226ecbf21a.png[/img] Attention[/b] - Affects the attention to details like the products on the cash register. This will make the employees scan the products correctly without missing anything. And don't forget, a perfect attendance at the cash register means a bonus tip 🧙.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/3fc55a580e42b04df2a86deb3e04ae1b5a7b7dcf.png[/img] Motivation[/b] - Affects the overall performance of the employee. Less stamina and happiness will be consumed while doing the tasks around the store.
[/list]

Beside that main stats, there are two other stats that define how employees behave:
[list]
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ad439a62cee40d11e9e0f525282664390c901346.png[/img] Stamina[/b] - Performing tasks consumes stamina. When this stamina gets too low, the worker will look for a comfort item (like a chair) to sit on and regain some stamina. The task being performed will be paused until the worker has recovered.
[*] [b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/5d94c6d711cd9ffef83d3db20d2dd7a2b436d4dc.png[/img] Happiness[/b] - Overall happiness of the worker. For now, it's just a base stat that is consumed while working in the shop. If the happiness gets too low, you may end up losing the employee.
[/list]

Both these stats are recovered during rest or when the employee is off duty.

Would like to leave it here noted that the current system is a base for further exploration and will be improved over time. It is by no means finished.
Also, you can't really train employees at the moment. You will have to hire new employees with new stats.

[h3]Staff Comfort Items[/h3]
Now staff will actively seek comfort while resting. Items while in the chair will help increase the stamina recovery. More items will be added soon! 😁


[h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42899082/ed018cb5c45fbe4c4c889b3db118828c0c75e339.png[/img] Notifications[/h3]
New notifications have been added to let you know some store management important decisions:
[list]
[*] [b]Recruitment Started[/b] - Who started the recruitment and how much it cost.
[*] [b]Recruitment Finished[/b] - Recruitment process finished and how much candidates it found.
[*] [b]Employee Hired[/b] - Who hired who!
[*] [b]Employee Fired[/b] -  Who fired who! Can't fire your friends 👌
[/list]

[h3]Customers[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Better route[/b] - Customers will now look for the best way to pay for the products and leave. This means that if a new cashier is open or a self-service cashier is free, they will try to go to it.
This allows players to effectively run 2 or more cashiers at the same time. If you need to speed up the payout, you can go to a new cashier and see the queue of the older ones split into the new one 😍.
[/list]

[h3]Administration App[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Staff Costs[/b] - Now you can check the daily costs of all employees in the Administration tab. Are they even worth 🤔?
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the drop bags could be stuck outside zone or at store wall.
[*] Fixed an issue where was impossible to skip night after readjust the store schedule.
[/list]

[h2]Language[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed translations errors in german and spanish.
[/list]
